spanish: Y tocarán con ellas, y se reunirá a ti toda la congregación a abertura de tienda de reunión.

findings.issue: Niphal sequential perfect is 3rd common plural; se reunirá is singular, smoothed to agree with singular כָּל הָעֵדָה. Same participants and niphal middle sense.

notes: Other tokens match: 3pl blow, with 3fp, to 2ms, all the congregation, to opening of tent of meeting.
